hooks.name: On-save test & lint
hooks.description: Run ruff and matching pytest on Python source files when saved

action.prompt: A Python source file under `src/` was just saved. Run `ruff check` on it and fix trivial lint issues. Then run the matching test file in `tests/` (e.g., `src/sentinel/features.py` -> `tests/test_features.py`) with pytest. If tests fail, summarize the failure and propose a minimal fix. Do not modify unrelated files. Keep changes small and leakage-free per the risk.md steering.
